title: crataegus pinnatifida f. major
intro: Crataegus pinnatifida f. major, commonly known as Chinese hawthorn, is a deciduous shrub or small tree in the rose family that is native to China. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including lowering blood pressure, improving cardiovascular health, and aiding in digestion. The therapeutic actions of Chinese hawthorn include vasodilation, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, triterpenoids, and oligosaccharides. The bioactive constituents of Chinese hawthorn have also been shown to have anti-diabetic, anti-cancer, and anti-aging properties, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
